feedback:
Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. It changes one value from the best raced design (iteration 5, score 506.7): controller.kd 0.5 to 0.6, with kp 1.5, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction and all geometry and sensor_weights unchanged. All fields are within the contract ranges, and the single-variable change keeps the result attributable.

The evidence supports this test. Raising kd from 0.3 to 0.5 (iteration 3) cut oval line loss from 1.1 to 0.55 and lifted the score from 163.8 to 326.7, with steering oscillation still below 0.4 on every track. Lowering kp from 2.0 to 1.7 to 1.5 (iterations 4 and 5) then helped the oval and s-bend, but slalom line loss stayed at 1.0 per run and slalom progress at about 0.24 in both. That pattern points to a damping or overshoot issue at the slalom direction changes that gain reduction has not fixed, so kd is the next untested lever.

The main risk is steering oscillation. At kd 0.5 it was 0.38 on the s-bend in iteration 5 and 0.40 at kp 1.7 in iteration 4, so kd 0.6 is close to the 0.4 guard, and the derivative term may amplify the roughly 2 percent sensor noise. Read the next race as follows. If s-bend or slalom steering_oscillation rises above 0.4 with no gain in line-loss events or progress, revert kd to 0.5 and keep kp 1.5. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 and progress rises above about 0.24 while oval finishes hold near 18 of 20, keep kd 0.6 as the new best. If slalom line loss stays at about 1.0 with oscillation under 0.4, the cause is not overshoot, so the next test should be controller.line_loss 'search_left' or 'search_right' on the same kd, as a comparison, rather than further kd or kp changes.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation on the s-bend or slalom exceeds 0.4 without a fall in line_loss_events, revert controller.kd to 0.5 (the iteration 5 value) and keep kp 1.5, because kd 0.5 gave 0.38 s-bend oscillation and kd 0.6 is close to the guard.

If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 with oscillation under 0.4 and oval finishes hold near 18 of 20, keep controller.kd 0.6 and kp 1.5, then test controller.base_speed 1.4 as the next single change, since speed becomes the limit once line loss is controlled.

If slalom line_loss_events stay at about 1.0 with kd 0.6, do not change kp or kd again; test controller.line_loss 'search_left' or 'search_right' with kd 0.6 as a comparison, because iterations 4 and 5 showed slalom line loss does not respond to kp.
